_comment: Where sync.mjs looks for each config and how to read it. build.mjs never reads this file.
_start_here: There are no agents configured yet, so sync will stop and tell you so rather than guessing. Copy the _example block below to a real key, point its path at your config, and run: node scripts/sync.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs
_the_key_is_the_filename: The key becomes data/<key>.json and becomes a tab. Picking claude-code or example overwrites one of the starter tabs shipped with this repo, which is fine once you no longer want them. git checkout data/ brings them back.
_adapters: skills-dir works for any config with skills/<name>/SKILL.md, agents/*.md and an optional mcp.json, and needs no code. claude-config also reads a curated docs/skills.json. codex-catalog reads skill-deck/catalog.json. Write your own in scripts/adapters/ if your layout differs.
_fields: path may be relative to this repo, absolute, or start with ~ for your home directory. adapter names a module in scripts/adapters/. borrowFrom is optional and lifts curated blurbs from another entry where skill names match. Everything else is identity: it is copied onto the payload, so adapters never hardcode your setup.
